change.summary: Pufferfish's Skills owns profession progression state; JEMProfessions presents its complete balanced 78-node graph in one radial screen and supplies audited gain signals and implemented effects. Iron's Spells receives the chosen native racial spell.

after.state: native category XP, levels, points and unlocked skills

modifiers.notes: Legacy JEM XP and enabled nodes migrate once; audit IDs, discovery caps and cooldown evidence remain in JEMProfessions. JEM presents but does not duplicate Pufferfish progression state.

Iron's first-person arms/items are disabled as required by the animation addon. The EFS ISS magic-sword skill can cast the selected spell and reduce its level while cooling down; this native addon behavior is an explicit balance surface.
SpellSelectionEvent adds only the chosen race spell to the standard Iron's Spells HUD and wheel; no physical scroll, crafting recipe or loot entry is created.

cause.owner: Pufferfish's Skills, JEMProfessions, EFIS Compat and EFS ISS

rationale.purpose: Use the purpose-built installed skill-tree mod instead of maintaining a competing JEM profession UI, and add the two requested Iron's Spells/Epic Fight integrations.
rationale.decision_source: User requests on 2026-10-14, including the clarification that Settlements must remain in the sidebar.

introduced.summary: Migrated profession progression to Pufferfish's Skills and added exact requested spell-combat addon versions.

history.summary: Removed the JEM tree/status packets and screens, generated native categories for all profession gains, retained Settlements navigation, and installed matching client/server addon JARs.

Restored the complete 57-node parent-child catalog in the Paxi source, added a one-screen JEM radial presentation over Pufferfish state, compacted race cards, enforced post-authentication choice and registered five native racial spell selections.

Expanded the catalog from 57 to 78 nodes so every profession branch reaches tier III, and changed the presentation from selected-only rows to one zoomable, pannable snowflake where all ten professions and every parent-child branch remain visible around the player.

notes: Installed artifact hashes: puffish B5DF0B2D3561486076BDFA9318CF143D05B3EAB0CCB93A009B396EEE1312CA8D; efiscompat C5EEF935E534139209E5BF002685C885662BC809D1C4E05AD1309BDA8EEA07AB; efs_iss D7F7A0405FF5B1C859513FF4BAF54238B18542FB43D7D3A84A1629F4EC328ACA.

unresolved: Player acceptance of the radial tree layout, compact race cards and native racial spell placement remains pending local replay.
